old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a fireplace, focusing on the dynamic flames dancing above the burning logs. The fire is contained within a dark, possibly metal or stone, structure that frames the scene. The flames are bright orange and yellow, flickering vigorously, casting a warm glow that illuminates the surrounding area. The logs inside the fireplace are partially consumed by the flames, with some charred remnants visible at the base. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent angle that emphasizes the intensity and movement of the fire. The background is dark, which contrasts sharply with the vivid colors of the flames, making them stand out prominently. There are no other objects or characters present in the frame, allowing the viewer to fully appreciate the natural beauty and power of the fire. The video highlights the mesmerizing dance of the flames, capturing the essence of warmth and comfort that a fire can provide.

caption: The video captures a fire already burning inside a dark fireplace, seen through a fixed arched opening with a horizontal glowing log bed at the bottom center. Two flame clusters rise from this bed: a smaller, steadier one on the left and a taller, more vigorous one on the right that repeatedly stretches upward and bends, forming hook-like curls against the dark upper space. Throughout the excerpt the flames continuously flicker, split, merge, and reshape themselves, their tongues lengthening and shortening without ever leaving the firebed. The left cluster leans and deforms, occasionally tilting toward the center, while the right cluster keeps the greater height and intensity from frame to frame. The central log glows and shifts in brightness but stays fixed in place, with no translation of the fuel visible. The surrounding brickwork and the lower frame bar hold their fixed positions. A few tiny bright specks appear intermittently in the upper-left darkness, drifting faintly like sparks or reflections. The combustion continues through the last frame, neither starting nor finishing within this excerpt.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
